resources.string: Leave empty to let the AI improvise
Your personal data has been redacted. The report will be deleted once the issue has been identified and fixed.

Kitsune has no AI server of its own. Add the API key of the provider you choose — OpenRouter, Mammouth, OpenAI or any compatible service — and your messages go straight from your phone to that provider, at their prices and under their retention rules.
All your conversations are stored LOCALLY and encrypted. If you uninstall Kitsune without exporting a backup first (Settings → Backup), there will be no way to recover them.
Kitsune focuses on immersion: long-term memory, lore tracking, a story director, novel mode. In case of a problem you can always produce an anonymised bug report and share it.

In Settings, you can enter your first name, age and other details so characters address you personally. This information stays on your phone and is only sent to your AI provider as context for your own conversations.

Kitsune sells nothing: no subscription, no in-app purchase, no ads. Its code is open source (GPL v3). Ideas are welcome on GitHub or through the marketplace proposals, and donations help keep the community marketplace server running.
Kitsune is an open-source role-playing and AI-assisted storytelling app. You bring your own AI provider; everything else stays on your phone.

• All your data is stored locally on your device, encrypted • Messages go directly from your phone to the AI provider you configured, over HTTPS — Kitsune has no server in between • The optional marketplace only ever receives what you choose to publish • No telemetry, no analytics, no ads

• Create custom personas and universes
• Immersive AI conversations
• Memory system for coherent stories
• Marketplace to share and discover content
• Proposal system to improve the app

Kitsune is free software and sells nothing. You can support it by:
• Making a donation (Settings → Support) • Suggesting improvements and voting on proposals • Contributing code or translations on GitHub • Sharing the app with your friends

Your feedback is essential to improve Kitsune. Feel free to:
• Open an issue or a discussion on GitHub • Suggest ideas through the marketplace proposals • Share an anonymised bug report from Settings
